  64 x 800G QSFP-DD800 AI and data centre 2RU switch on a Broadcom Tomahawk 5 with an Intel Xeon D-1713NTE
  and an OpenBMC service processor, sold as the AIS800-64D. All ports are on the FRONT in TWO BANKS of
  sixteen stacked columns, with two 25G SFP28 in-band management cages, an RJ-45 management jack, a USB
  3.0 Type-A storage port, an RJ-45 console, a ToD jack, 1PPS and 10 MHz timing jacks, six system lamps
  and a reset button; two 3000 W supplies and FOUR fan trays are on the rear. Its twin edgecore/ais800-64o
  is the same chassis with an OSFP800 wall. This is NOT a taller AIS800-32D: the 32-port models are a
  438.4 x 589 x 44 shell with seven 1RU trays and 2400 W Saf-D-Grid supplies, and this is a 440 x 649.2
  x 87 shell with four 2RU trays and 3000 W C20 supplies. Nothing crosses over.


  Configuration `ac-f2b`: Dual 3000 W AC PSUs, front-to-back airflow - red tray bars and red PSU latches,
  which is the build the rear elevation and the datasheet''s first rear photograph show. Rated 0-40 C
  at 1800 m.

  optics

comments: "IP Infusion lists UfiSpace S9610-46DX (NOS: ocnos).\nListed per: OcNOS 7.0.1 MR Hardware Compatibility\
  \ List (IP Infusion, July 2026), the row for S9610-46DX, current supported 'SP 7.0.1'. The names follow\
  \ OcNOS's pattern rather than a table for this box: the port's speed class as prefix (ge 1G, xe 10G\
  \ and 25G, ce 40G and 100G, cd 400G) and one 0-based count across the whole front panel, with eth0 for\
  \ management. That is how the S9510-30XC's own configuration in the OcNOS SP 7.0 Segment Routing Guide\
  \ names its ports - ce0, ce1, xe2 to xe29 - and it is exactly the UfiSpace silkscreen numbering, which\
  \ this box shares. Not every platform counts this way: the AS7316-26XB example in the Layer 3 Guide\
  \ restarts at xe0 after ce0 and ce1, so the rule is applied to UfiSpace boxes whose ports are numbered\
  \ in one run from 0, and nowhere else.\n\nUfiSpace S9610-46DX 100G/400G open aggregation router - 2RU\
  \ white box on Broadcom Qumran2c+ at 7.2 Tbps with an 8 GB deep buffer and a Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external\
  \ TCAM, 40x QSFP28 40/100G in two blocks of five four-high columns, 6x QSFP-DD 100/400G with 400ZR/OpenZR+\
  \ in one 3x2 assembly in the middle, 4x SFP28/SFP-DD 1/10/25G that share in-band with 100GE port 0,\
  \ and a separate quad of 10G SFP+ management ports; a full timing block (GNSS on SMA, 10MHz and 1PPS\
  \ on SMB, ToD on RJ45 and BITS on RJ48) with a Stratum 3E OCXO and Class C 1588v2, MACsec on all ports;\
  \ four hot-swap fans (3+1) and dual 2000 W PSUs (1+1) at the rear, orderable AC or DC, exhaust airflow\n\
  \nConfiguration `ac`: The chassis as HIG Figure 7's rear elevation and the vendor rear product render\
  \ both draw it - four FAN-808012-HCE exhaust fans and two PSU-202-AESR 2000 W AC supplies with a large\
  \ C20 inlet and a red cord clip, front-to-back airflow, and the fifty-four traffic and management ports\
  \ empty. The HIG rates the feed at 200-240 V and mates it with an IEC60320 C19 cord; on a single 110\
  \ VAC source each supply delivers 1000 W. Maximum system consumption 1263 W under 400G MSA optics, 1534\
  \ W with OpenZR+. No orderable chassis part number appears in any held document; see the chassis-sku\
  \ gap.\n\nRail kits: ufispace/adjustable-rail-771-kit@1 (in the box).\n\nDatasheet: UfiSpace S9610-46DX\
  \ 46-Port 100G/400G Open Aggregation Router Datasheet\n  https://www.ufispace.com/products/telco/aggregation/s9610-46dx-46-port-100-400g-open-aggregation-router\n\
  \nFacts carried in the model that this schema has no field for:\n- compliance.emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart\
  \ B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 55035; EN\
  \ 62479; EN 50663; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A\n- compliance.environment: WEEE\n- compliance.nebs: NEBS GR-1089;\
  \ NEBS GR-63\n- compliance.safety: UL 62368-1; IEC 62368-1\n- environmental.operating-humidity: 5 to\
  \ 85% RH non-condensing\n- environmental.operating-temp: 0 to 45 C\n- environmental.storage-humidity:\
  \ 5 to 93% RH non-condensing\n- environmental.storage-temp: -40 to 70 C\n- features.macsec: MACsec supported\
  \ on all ports (datasheet key benefits)\n- features.optics-qsfp-dd: 400G QSFP-DD SR/LR/ER/ZR/OpenZR+,\
  \ up to 600 km (HIG port table, ports 40-45)\n- features.optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR/LR/ER/ZR/OpenZR+,\
  \ up to 80 km; 40G (HIG port table, ports 0-39)\n- features.optics-sfp-plus: NOT STATED. The four SFP+\
  \ management ports are named '4 x 10G SFP+ management ports' by the datasheet and '4x SFP+ Management'\
  \ by HIG Figure 4, and the HIG's Port Overview table - the only place that gives reach and supported\
  \ optics per port - has no row for them at all. 10G SFP+ is the form factor and speed the vendor states;\
  \ which reaches are qualified in them is recorded as a gap rather than assumed from the SFP28 row above\n\
  - features.optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR; 10G SFP+ SR/LR, up to 40 km (HIG port table, ports 46-49)\n\
  - features.sfp28-sharing: the four SFP28/SFP-DD ports are in-band port share with 100GE port 0 (datasheet)\n\
  - features.timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover performance, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (default,\
  \ G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with an additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC, Class\
  \ C timing accuracy; NOS integration is required to activate any of it\n- features.timing-cable: 50\
  \ ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector\
  \ for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD, shielded RJ48 for BITS (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable\
  \ Types)\n- features.timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMB, 1PPS in/out on SMB, ToD\
  \ in/out on RJ45, BITS in/out on RJ48\n- lifecycle.eol: none-announced\n- management.console: RJ45 RS-232\
  \ plus a micro-USB serial console\n- management.oob: 1x RJ45 100/1000M\n- management.sfp-plus-management:\
  \ 4x 10G SFP+ management ports, numbered 0-3 in their own run\n- performance.packet-buffer: 8 GB\n-\

  \ OP2 BCM16K external TCAM\n- platform.bmc: Aspeed AST2620\n- platform.cpu: Intel Icelake-D 8-core @\
  \ 2.1 GHz\n- platform.memory: 64 GB DDR4 (up to 128 GB)\n- platform.storage: 128 GB SSD (up to 2x 256\
  \ GB)\n- platform.tcam: TCAM option available to meet diverse deployment requirements (datasheet)\n\
  - power.input-ac: 200 to 240 V, 12.5 A\n- power.input-dc: -40 to -72 V, 60 A\n- power.power-envelope:\
  \ bare\n- power.power-max-w: 1534\n- power.power-typical-w: 626\n- power.psu-redundancy: 1+1 hot-swappable\n\
  - thermal.airflow: front-to-back (exhaust fans and exhaust PSUs)\n- thermal.fan-redundancy: 3+1 hot-swappable\n\
  \nDrawing version 4.1.2. A major bump means a slot moved or an id was renamed, so anything cached from\
  \ an earlier export may no longer line up.\nModel maturity: modelled. Every dimension in the source\
  \ records where it came from."
